name: Gravity earthquake alarm
subtitle: warns of big quakes before the shaking arrives

effects.effect: atoms cooled almost to absolute zero behave as a single wave
two masses pull on each other measurably
strain builds on a fault until it suddenly slips

effect: atoms cooled almost to absolute zero behave as a single wave
how: Earthquake warnings today wait for the first seismic waves, which leaves people near the fault almost no time. When a big fault slips, a vast mass of rock moves and its pull changes everywhere at the speed of light; a cloud of atoms chilled until they act as one wave is split and rejoined, and the tiny change in gravity shows up in how the two halves line up, seconds before the ground starts moving.
obstacle: The gravity jolt is under a billionth of normal gravity and is drowned by the ground's own trembling, so sensors need about a thousand times more sensitivity.
why: Light-speed gravity signals were spotted in old records in 2017; nothing yet warns with them.
real: Juhel et al. 2018 model PEGS-based early warning with proposed gravity strainmeters incl. atom interferometers; none built, only seismometer-based PEGS analysis exists.
